domains.bytes: Only a genuine standard Uint8Array in the current realm; intrinsic tag before reflection, intrinsic slice, no shared/resizable/detached backing, subclass/Buffer/foreign realm/proxy/symbol/enumerable-extra rejected. Nonenumerable string decorations ignored. Synchronous Core-exclusive copy of the exact view before any callback or await, physical 25 MiB cap. Caller view is not frozen or changed.
domains.json: Browser request and signature policy ingress accepts only a primitive string. Check typeof before parsing or reflection; do not coerce, stringify, structuredClone or inspect caller objects. Existing strict.parseJson preserves rejection of duplicate and escaped-duplicate keys, scalar/UTF8/depth/array/byte bounds. Only its newly parsed private graph enters exact source-generated validation. Identifier additionally uses the existing UTF8 byte/control/surrogate predicate. No aliases, defaults or tuple conversion for requests.
domains.opaque: Request tokens reuse the single existing section-native-state.requests WeakMap. The parsed frozen request and its existing digestCanonical are held there. A fresh object, JSON copy, forwarding Proxy or foreign instance cannot acquire a brand. Browser authorities have one new private same-instance registry; no parallel snapshot/request brand.
domains.callback: The embedding supplies a trusted callback. Registration checks typeof function and stores it privately without reading properties or invoking it. A callable Proxy is within this trusted embedding domain; the registration zero-hook promise does not promise a future callback invocation has no user effects.
domains.failure: New trusted failures are classified only through a private WeakMap. Unknown thrown objects, Error.code/reason aliases, getters, proxies and wrapped genuine errors are never inspected or converted into trusted reasons. Parsing errors from the trusted parser are normalized at that internal parser boundary to a newly branded READ_INPUT_INVALID. Unknown future pipeline failures remain capability unavailable with null diagnostics.
